name: sftp-retry-grounded
intent: Make the SFTP poller resilient to transient network failures
documentation: The SpringIntegrationSftpConfiguration poller currently aborts the whole flow on a socket timeout. Operations have asked for bounded retries with exponential backoff and an alert after the final attempt.

name: s3-listing-pagination
intent: Handle paginated results when listing S3 objects
documentation: SpringIntegrationS3Configuration lists objects but only reads the first page of results, so buckets with more than 1000 objects are silently truncated.

name: no-documentation-available
intent: Add a health endpoint that reports downstream connectivity
